usNews.title: Why the market isn't buying Salesforce's AI story
usNews.description: Salesforce is betting heavily on AI across its products, operations and acquisitions. The company is already seeing productivity gains, but investors are still waiting for proof that AI can drive durable growth.

tip.title: Date Night Idea: Swap Bucket Lists
tip.content: Ask your girlfriend to share 3 things on her bucket list you didn't know about. Listen without planning. Then share yours. This creates deeper connection in 15 minutes.
